standard.summary: 选择少步蒸馏路线：dp_dmd_turbo 是主少步路径；anyflow 是 flow-matching 一致性蒸馏，需配合「自蒸馏教师」才是少步加速路径。
standard.effect: dp_dmd_turbo 走 DP-DMD 家族（实现模式见「DP-DMD 实现模式」）；anyflow 走 FM 一致性蒸馏，单独打开不会获得少步加速。
standard.whenToUse: 目标是用更少采样步数出图时选择；默认 dp_dmd_turbo。
standard.avoidWhen: 只想正常多步训练、没有蒸馏诉求时不要开启 distillation_enabled。

standard_en.summary: Pick the few-step distillation route: dp_dmd_turbo is the primary few-step path; anyflow is flow-matching consistency distillation and only becomes a few-step accelerator together with the self-distillation teacher.
standard_en.effect: dp_dmd_turbo goes through the DP-DMD family (see DP-DMD implementation mode); anyflow goes through FM consistency distillation and does not yield few-step speedups on its own.
standard_en.whenToUse: Choose this when the goal is sampling with fewer steps; the default is dp_dmd_turbo.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not enable distillation_enabled when you just want normal multi-step training.

advanced.principle: 蒸馏模式决定损失构造路线；DP-DMD 的 provider 组合与更新节奏由 dp_dmd_variant 决定。
advanced.expectedImpact: 理论上降低推理步数；训练成本取决于 teacher 生成和 质量门槛。
advanced.tradeoffs: standard 当前为单进程路径且需要三套独立 DiT；旧 cache 迁移会重新编码数据。它不会退回 raw-Qwen 或 teacher MSE，两种模式的训练成本和质量不能互相外推。

advanced_en.principle: The distillation mode picks the loss-construction route; the provider combination and update cadence of DP-DMD are decided by dp_dmd_variant.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Theoretically reduces inference steps; training cost depends on teacher generation and the quality gate.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: standard is currently a single-process path requiring three independent DiTs; legacy cache migration re-encodes data. It does not fall back to raw-Qwen or teacher MSE, and the two modes' training cost and quality cannot be extrapolated to each other.
